title: mris_place_surface
description: This program positions the triangular mesh representing a cortical surface, either the 'white' surface (ie, white/gray boundary) or the 'pial' surface (ie, the gray/csf boundary).

input_volume.description: T1-weighed intensity volume used to find white/gray/csf gradients (usually brain.finalsurf.mgz)
input_volume.title: Input Volume

surface_type_group.description: Place the white surface or the pial surface. Must choose one.
surface_type_group.title: Surface Type

hemi_group.description: Left or right hemisphere. Must choose one.
hemi_group.title: Hemisphere

out_volume_only.description: Save input volume after preprocessing and then exit
out_volume_only.title: Output Volume Only

restore_255.description: Set voxels in the input volume that start off as 255 to 110 (white surf only).
restore_255.title: Restore 255 Flag

cortical_parcellation.description: Set cortical parcellation used to rip vertices (usually ?h.aparc.annot)
cortical_parcellation.title: Cortical Parcellation

nsmooth.description: Smooth input surface by number of iterations
nsmooth.title: Number of Smooth Iterations

max_cbv_dist.description: Limit distance MRIScomputeBorderValues() can search from the input
max_cbv_dist.title: Max CBV Distance

rip_label.description: Do not move vertices that are NOT in the cortex label
rip_label.title: Rip Label

rip_midline.description: Do not move vertices that are in the midline as indicated by the seg
rip_midline.title: Rip Midline Flag

rip_bg.description: Do not move vertices near basal ganglia (as defined by seg)
rip_bg.title: Rip Basal Ganglia Flag

rip_bg_no_annot.description: Do not require surface have an annotation when ripping BG
rip_bg_no_annot.title: Rip BG No Annotation Flag

no_rip_freeze.description: Do NOT move vertices in/near freeze voxels (247 as defined in seg)
no_rip_freeze.title: No Rip Freeze Flag

rip_wmsa.description: Do not move vertices in/near white-matter signal abnormalities (77,78,79 as defined in seg)
rip_wmsa.title: Rip WMSA Flag

rip_lesion.description: Do not move vertices in/near lesions (25 and 57 as defined in seg)
rip_lesion.title: Rip Lesion Flag

rip_overlay.description: Rip vertices > 0.5 in the surface overlay file
rip_overlay.title: Rip Overlay

rip_surface.description: Use this surface with ripping midline, BG, Freezes, Lesions, and WMSA.
rip_surface.title: Rip Surface

rip_projection.description: Control projection depth along normal to ripsurface when sampling seg
rip_projection.title: Rip Projection

repulse_surface.description: Force input surface away from this surface (usually the white surface when placing the pial).
repulse_surface.title: Repulse Surface

white_surface.description: Set the white{xyz} coordinates of the input surface using this surface.
white_surface.title: White Surface

blend_surface.description: Recompute the xyz coordinates of the input surface by computing a weighted average with the blend surface.
blend_surface.title: Blend Surface

multimodal_input.description: Specify a T2 or FLAIR input volume used for placing the pial surface. Must be in registration with the input volume.
multimodal_input.title: MultiModal Input Volume

pin_medial_wall.description: Set coordinates in vertices NOT in cortexlabel to be that of the white{xyz} coordinates.
pin_medial_wall.title: Pin Medial Wall

no_intensity_proc.description: Do not process the input intensity volume (eg, to remove parts of eye socket).
no_intensity_proc.title: No Intensity Processing Flag

stop_mask.description: Stop mask to stop search along normal for max gradient
stop_mask.title: Stop Mask Flag

mm_intensity_limits.description: Intensity limits for placing pial on multimodal input.
mm_intensity_limits.title: Multimodal Intensity Limits

cover_seg.description: Force surface to cover the segmentation
cover_seg.title: Cover Segmentation

first_peak_d1.description: Use find-first-peak option with 1st derivative in ComputeBorderValues
first_peak_d1.title: First Peak D1 Flag

first_peak_d2.description: Use find-first-peak option with 2nd derivative in ComputeBorderValues
first_peak_d2.title: First Peak D2 Flag
